// Flutter web plugin registrant file.
//
// Generated file. Do not edit.
//

// @dart = 2.13
// ignore_for_file: type=lint

import 'package:cloud_firestore_web/cloud_firestore_web.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth_web/firebase_auth_web.dart';
import 'package:firebase_core_web/firebase_core_web.dart';
import 'package:firebase_messaging_web/firebase_messaging_web.dart';
import 'package:image_picker_for_web/image_picker_for_web.dart';
import 'package:flutter_web_plugins/flutter_web_plugins.dart';

void registerPlugins([final Registrar? pluginRegistrar]) {
  final Registrar registrar = pluginRegistrar ?? webPluginRegistrar;
  FirebaseFirestoreWeb.registerWith(registrar);
  FirebaseAuthWeb.registerWith(registrar);
  FirebaseCoreWeb.registerWith(registrar);
  FirebaseMessagingWeb.registerWith(registrar);
  ImagePickerPlugin.registerWith(registrar);
  registrar.registerMessageHandler();
}

class Antrean {
  final String id;
  final String uid;
  final String nomorAntrean;
  final String namaPoli;
  final String dokter;
  final String status;
  final DateTime waktuAmbil;
  final DateTime? waktuDipanggil;
  final DateTime? waktuSelesai;

  Antrean({
    required this.id,
    required this.uid,
    required this.nomorAntrean,
    required this.namaPoli,
    required this.dokter,
    required this.status,
    required this.waktuAmbil,
    this.waktuDipanggil,
    this.waktuSelesai,
  });

  factory Antrean.fromFirestore(String id, Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    return Antrean(
      id: id,
      uid: data['uid'] ?? '',
      nomorAntrean: data['nomorAntrean'] ?? '',
      namaPoli: data['namaPoli'] ?? '',
      dokter: data['dokter'] ?? '',
      status: data['status'] ?? 'Menunggu',
      waktuAmbil: (data['waktuAmbil'] as dynamic).toDate(),
      waktuDipanggil: data['waktuDipanggil'] != null
          ? (data['waktuDipanggil'] as dynamic).toDate()
          : null,
      waktuSelesai: data['waktuSelesai'] != null
          ? (data['waktuSelesai'] as dynamic).toDate()
          : null,
    );
  }
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

/// Model untuk menyimpan dan membaca data kepuasan layanan pasien.
class KepuasanLayanan {
  final String id;
  final String uidPasien;
  final String idAntrean;
  final String namaPasien;
  final String namaPoli;
  final String dokter;
  final int ratingKeseluruhan;
  final int ratingPetugas;
  final int ratingWaktuTunggu;
  final int ratingDokter;
  final String komentar;
  final Timestamp? tanggalPenilaian;

  const KepuasanLayanan({
    required this.id,
    required this.uidPasien,
    required this.idAntrean,
    required this.namaPasien,
    required this.namaPoli,
    required this.dokter,
    required this.ratingKeseluruhan,
    required this.ratingPetugas,
    required this.ratingWaktuTunggu,
    required this.ratingDokter,
    required this.komentar,
    this.tanggalPenilaian,
  });

  factory KepuasanLayanan.dariFirestore(
    DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> doc,
  ) {
    final data = doc.data() ?? {};

    return KepuasanLayanan(
      id: doc.id,
      uidPasien: data['uidPasien'] as String? ?? '',
      idAntrean: data['idAntrean'] as String? ?? doc.id,
      namaPasien: data['namaPasien'] as String? ?? 'Pasien',
      namaPoli: data['namaPoli'] as String? ?? '-',
      dokter: data['dokter'] as String? ?? '-',
      ratingKeseluruhan: (data['ratingKeseluruhan'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      ratingPetugas: (data['ratingPetugas'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      ratingWaktuTunggu:
          (data['ratingWaktuTunggu'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      ratingDokter: (data['ratingDokter'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0,
      komentar: data['komentar'] as String? ?? '',
      tanggalPenilaian: data['tanggalPenilaian'] as Timestamp?,
    );
  }

  Map<String, dynamic> keMap() {
    return {
      'uidPasien': uidPasien,
      'idAntrean': idAntrean,
      'namaPasien': namaPasien,
      'namaPoli': namaPoli,
      'dokter': dokter,
      'ratingKeseluruhan': ratingKeseluruhan,
      'ratingPetugas': ratingPetugas,
      'ratingWaktuTunggu': ratingWaktuTunggu,
      'ratingDokter': ratingDokter,
      'komentar': komentar,
      'tanggalPenilaian': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    };
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

// ==========================================================
// ABSTRACT CLASS POLI
// ==========================================================

abstract class Poli {
  // ========================================================
  // DATA DASAR POLI
  // ========================================================

  String nama;
  String dokter;
  int jumlahAntrian;
  IconData icon;
  String gambar;

  // ========================================================
  // DATA DETAIL POLI
  // ========================================================

  String deskripsi;
  String jamPelayanan;
  String lokasi;
  List<String> layanan;

  // ========================================================
  // CONSTRUCTOR
  // ========================================================

  Poli({
    required this.nama,
    required this.dokter,
    required this.jumlahAntrian,
    required this.icon,
    required this.gambar,
    required this.deskripsi,
    required this.jamPelayanan,
    required this.lokasi,
    required this.layanan,
  });

  // ========================================================
  // METHOD ABSTRACT
  // ========================================================

  String getInfo();
}

    : super(

            'konsultasi mengenai keluhan kesehatan sebelum '
            'pasien mendapatkan penanganan atau pemeriksaan '
            'lebih lanjut.',

        jamPelayanan: '08.00 - 15.00',

        lokasi: 'Lantai 1 - Ruang 101',

        layanan: [
          'Pemeriksaan kesehatan umum',

          'Pemeriksaan kondisi umum',
        ],
      );

    return 'Pemeriksaan kesehatan umum untuk pasien.';
  }
}

===== C:\Users\USER\sistem-antrian-klinik\lib\pages\about_me_page.dart =====
import 'dart:typed_data';

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

import '../services/database_service.dart';
import '../services/profile_photo_service.dart';
import 'edit_profile_page.dart';

class AboutMePage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AboutMePage({super.key});

  @override
  State<AboutMePage> createState() => _AboutMePageState();
}

class _AboutMePageState extends State<AboutMePage> {
  // ==========================================================
  // DATA PROFIL
  // ==========================================================

  String nama = '-';

  String email = '-';

  String jenisKelamin = '-';

  String tempatLahir = '-';

  String tanggalLahir = '-';

  String golonganDarah = '-';

  String nomorTelepon = '-';

  String alamat = '-';

  // ==========================================================
  // STATUS
  // ==========================================================

  bool isLoading = true;

  // ==========================================================
  // INIT STATE
  // ==========================================================

  @override
  void initState() {
    super.initState();

    ambilDataUser();
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // AMBIL DATA USER
  // ==========================================================

  Future<void> ambilDataUser() async {
    try {
      // ======================================================
      // MENGAMBIL USER YANG SEDANG LOGIN
      // ======================================================

      final User? user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;

      // ======================================================
      // JIKA USER TIDAK ADA
      // ======================================================

      if (user == null) {
        if (mounted) {
          setState(() {
            nama = '-';

            email = '-';

            isLoading = false;
          });
        }

        return;
      }

      // ======================================================
      // AMBIL DATA DARI FIRESTORE
      // ======================================================

      final document = await DatabaseService.ambilUser(user.uid);

      // ======================================================
      // JIKA DATA FIRESTORE ADA
      // ======================================================

      if (document.exists) {
        final data = document.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

        if (!mounted) {
          return;
        }

        setState(() {
          // ==================================================
          // NAMA
          // ==================================================

          nama = data['nama'] ?? user.displayName ?? '-';

          // ==================================================
          // EMAIL
          // ==================================================

          email = data['email'] ?? user.email ?? '-';

          // ==================================================
          // JENIS KELAMIN
          // ==================================================

          final String jenisKelaminData = data['jenisKelamin'] ?? '';

          jenisKelamin = jenisKelaminData.isEmpty ? '-' : jenisKelaminData;

          // ==================================================
          // TEMPAT LAHIR
          // ==================================================

          final String tempatLahirData = data['tempatLahir'] ?? '';

          tempatLahir = tempatLahirData.isEmpty ? '-' : tempatLahirData;

          // ==================================================
          // TANGGAL LAHIR
          // ==================================================

          final String tanggalLahirData = data['tanggalLahir'] ?? '';

          if (tanggalLahirData.isEmpty) {
            tanggalLahir = '-';
          } else {
            final DateTime? tanggal = DateTime.tryParse(tanggalLahirData);

            if (tanggal != null) {
              tanggalLahir = formatTanggal(tanggal);
            } else {
              tanggalLahir = tanggalLahirData;
            }
          }

          // ==================================================
          // GOLONGAN DARAH
          // ==================================================

          final String golonganDarahData = data['golonganDarah'] ?? '';

          golonganDarah = golonganDarahData.isEmpty ? '-' : golonganDarahData;

          // ==================================================
          // NOMOR TELEPON
          // ==================================================

          final String nomorTeleponData = data['nomorTelepon'] ?? '';

          nomorTelepon = nomorTeleponData.isEmpty ? '-' : nomorTeleponData;

          // ==================================================
          // ALAMAT
          // ==================================================

          final String alamatData = data['alamat'] ?? '';

          alamat = alamatData.isEmpty ? '-' : alamatData;
        });
      }
      // ======================================================
      // JIKA DATA FIRESTORE BELUM ADA
      // ======================================================
      else {
        if (!mounted) {
          return;
        }

        setState(() {
          nama = user.displayName ?? '-';

          email = user.email ?? '-';

          jenisKelamin = '-';

          tempatLahir = '-';

          tanggalLahir = '-';

          golonganDarah = '-';

          nomorTelepon = '-';

          alamat = '-';
        });
      }
    }
    // ========================================================
    // ERROR
    // ========================================================
    catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) {
        return;
      }

      ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
        SnackBar(
          content: Text('Gagal mengambil data profil: $e'),
          backgroundColor: Colors.red,
        ),
      );
    }

    // ========================================================
    // SELESAI LOADING
    // ========================================================

    if (mounted) {
      setState(() {
        isLoading = false;
      });
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FORMAT TANGGAL
  // ==========================================================

  String formatTanggal(DateTime tanggal) {
    final String hari = tanggal.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    final String bulan = tanggal.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    final String tahun = tanggal.year.toString();

    return '$hari-$bulan-$tahun';
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // NAMA BULAN
  // ==========================================================

  String namaBulan(int bulan) {
    const List<String> daftarBulan = [
      'Januari',

      'Februari',

      'Maret',

      'April',

      'Mei',

      'Juni',

      'Juli',

      'Agustus',

      'September',

      'Oktober',

      'November',

      'Desember',
    ];

    return daftarBulan[bulan - 1];
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FOTO PROFIL
  // ==========================================================

  Widget buildFotoProfil() {
    return ValueListenableBuilder<Uint8List?>(
      valueListenable: ProfilePhotoService.fotoProfil,

      builder: (context, foto, child) {
        // ====================================================
        // JIKA USER SUDAH MEMILIH FOTO
        // ====================================================

        if (foto != null) {
          return CircleAvatar(
            radius: 60,

            backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade100,

            backgroundImage: MemoryImage(foto),
          );
        }

        // ====================================================
        // FOTO DEFAULT
        // ====================================================

        return const CircleAvatar(
          radius: 60,

          backgroundColor: Colors.blue,

          backgroundImage: AssetImage('assets/profile/profil.png'),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // CARD INFORMASI
  // ==========================================================

  Widget buildInfoCard({
    required String judul,
    required String isi,
    required IconData icon,
  }) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,

      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 12),

      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),

      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,

        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(15),

        boxShadow: [
          BoxShadow(
            color: Colors.grey.withValues(alpha: 0.10),

            blurRadius: 8,

            offset: const Offset(0, 3),
          ),
        ],
      ),

      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

        children: [
          // ==================================================
          // ICON
          // ==================================================

          Container(
            width: 45,

            height: 45,

            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.blue.shade50,

              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
            ),

            child: Icon(icon, color: Colors.blue),
          ),

          const SizedBox(width: 15),

          // ==================================================
          // TEXT
          // ==================================================
          Expanded(
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,

              children: [
                Text(
                  judul,

                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 13,

                    color: Colors.grey,

                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w500,
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 5),

                Text(
                  isi,

                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 15,

                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,

                    color: Colors.black87,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // BUILD
  // ==========================================================

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      // ======================================================
      // APP BAR
      // ======================================================

      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'About Me',

          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),

        actions: [
          // ==================================================
          // TOMBOL EDIT
          // ==================================================

          IconButton(
            icon: const Icon(Icons.edit),

            tooltip: 'Edit Profil',

            onPressed: () async {
              // Membuka halaman Edit Profil
              await Navigator.push(
                context,

                MaterialPageRoute(
                  builder: (context) => const EditProfilePage(),
                ),
              );

              // =================================================
              // SETELAH KEMBALI DARI EDIT PROFIL
              // =================================================

              // Ambil ulang data Firestore
              ambilDataUser();

              // Foto otomatis berubah karena
              // menggunakan ValueListenableBuilder.
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),

      // ======================================================
      // BODY
      // ======================================================
      body:
          // ==================================================
          // LOADING
          // ==================================================
          isLoading
          ? const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator())
          // =================================================
          // ISI ABOUT ME
          // =================================================
          : RefreshIndicator(
              onRefresh: ambilDataUser,

              child: SingleChildScrollView(
                physics: const AlwaysScrollableScrollPhysics(),

                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),

                child: Column(
                  children: [
                    // ==================================================
                    // FOTO PROFIL
                    // ==================================================

                    buildFotoProfil(),

                    const SizedBox(height: 15),

                    // ==================================================
                    // NAMA
                    // ==================================================
                    Text(
                      nama,

                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,

                      style: const TextStyle(
                        fontSize: 24,

                        fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                      ),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 5),

                    // ==================================================
                    // EMAIL
                    // ==================================================
                    Text(
                      email,

                      textAlign: TextAlign.center,

                      style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey, fontSize: 14),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 25),

                    // ==================================================
                    // JUDUL DATA PRIBADI
                    // ==================================================
                    const Align(
                      alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,

                      child: Text(
                        'Informasi Pribadi',

                        style: TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 20,

                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),

                    const SizedBox(height: 15),

                    // ==================================================
                    // JENIS KELAMIN
                    // ==================================================
                    buildInfoCard(
                      judul: 'Jenis Kelamin',

                      isi: jenisKelamin,

                      icon: Icons.people,
                    ),

                    // ==================================================
                    // TEMPAT LAHIR
                    // ==================================================
                    buildInfoCard(

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

import '../services/antrean_service.dart';

class AdminAntreanPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdminAntreanPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<AdminAntreanPage> createState() => _AdminAntreanPageState();
}

class _AdminAntreanPageState extends State<AdminAntreanPage> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();

  String _kataKunci = '';
  String _filterStatus = 'Semua';

  final List<String> _pilihanStatus = [
    'Semua',
    'Menunggu',
    'Dipanggil',
    'Selesai',
    'Dibatalkan',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MEMERIKSA DATA SESUAI PENCARIAN
  // ============================================================

  bool _cocokDenganPencarian(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final nomorAntrean =
        (data['nomorAntrean'] ?? '-').toString().toLowerCase();

    final namaPoli = (data['namaPoli'] ?? '-').toString().toLowerCase();

    final dokter = (data['dokter'] ?? '-').toString().toLowerCase();

    final status = (data['status'] ?? 'Menunggu').toString();

    final cocokKataKunci = nomorAntrean.contains(_kataKunci) ||
        namaPoli.contains(_kataKunci) ||
        dokter.contains(_kataKunci) ||
        status.toLowerCase().contains(_kataKunci);

    final cocokStatus =
        _filterStatus == 'Semua' || status == _filterStatus;

    return cocokKataKunci && cocokStatus;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MEMBANGUN HALAMAN
  // ============================================================

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF5F9FF),

      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Kelola Antrean',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
      ),

      body: Column(
        children: [
          // ======================================================
          // BAGIAN PENCARIAN DAN FILTER
          // ======================================================

          Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.blue,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                bottom: Radius.circular(24),
              ),
            ),

            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Cari Antrean Pasien',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 18,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 12),

                // Kolom pencarian
                TextField(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  focusNode: _searchFocusNode,

                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setState(() {
                      _kataKunci = value.trim().toLowerCase();
                    });
                  },

                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Nomor antrean, poli, atau dokter...',
                    hintStyle: TextStyle(color: Colors.grey.shade600),

                    prefixIcon: const Icon(
                      Icons.search,
                      color: Colors.blue,
                    ),

                    suffixIcon: _kataKunci.isNotEmpty
                        ? IconButton(
                            tooltip: 'Hapus pencarian',
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                            onPressed: () {
                              _searchController.clear();

                              setState(() {
                                _kataKunci = '';
                              });

                              _searchFocusNode.requestFocus();
                            },
                          )
                        : null,

                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.white,

                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 16,
                      vertical: 15,
                    ),

                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),

                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),

                    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      borderSide: const BorderSide(
                        color: Colors.lightBlueAccent,
                        width: 2,
                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 14),

                const Text(
                  'Filter berdasarkan status',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 8),

                // Filter status yang dapat digeser secara horizontal
                SingleChildScrollView(
                  scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,

                  child: Row(
                    children: _pilihanStatus.map((status) {
                      final terpilih = _filterStatus == status;

                      return Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),

                        child: ChoiceChip(
                          label: Text(status),
                          selected: terpilih,

                          onSelected: (selected) {
                            if (selected) {
                              setState(() {
                                _filterStatus = status;
                              });
                            }
                          },

                          selectedColor: Colors.white,
                          backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade400,

                          labelStyle: TextStyle(
                            color: terpilih
                                ? Colors.blue.shade800
                                : Colors.white,
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                          ),

                          side: BorderSide(
                            color: terpilih
                                ? Colors.white
                                : Colors.blue.shade300,
                          ),

                          showCheckmark: false,
                        ),
                      );
                    }).toList(),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          // ======================================================
          // DAFTAR ANTREAN REAL-TIME
          // ======================================================

          Expanded(
            child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
              stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                  .collection('antrean')
                  .snapshots(),

              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                  return const Center(
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(),

                }

                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return Center(

                        'Terjadi kesalahan:\n${snapshot.error}',
                        textAlign: TextAlign.center,

                  );

                if (!snapshot.hasData || snapshot.data!.docs.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildEmptyState(
                    icon: Icons.queue_outlined,
                    judul: 'Belum ada antrean',
                    deskripsi: 'Antrean pasien akan muncul di sini.',
                  );
                }

                final semuaDocs = snapshot.data!.docs;

                // Terapkan pencarian dan filter pada data Firestore
                final docs = semuaDocs.where((doc) {
                  final data = doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;
                  return _cocokDenganPencarian(data);
                }).toList();

                if (docs.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildEmptyState(
                    icon: Icons.search_off,
                    judul: 'Antrean tidak ditemukan',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Coba kata kunci lain atau ubah filter status.',

                          ),

                          const SizedBox(width: 8),

                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              '${docs.length} antrean ditemukan',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                fontSize: 15,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    // Daftar kartu antrean
                    Expanded(
                      child: ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                        itemCount: docs.length,

                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final doc = docs[index];

                          final data =
                              doc.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

                          final nomorAntrean =
                              (data['nomorAntrean'] ?? '-').toString();

                          final namaPoli =
                              (data['namaPoli'] ?? '-').toString();

                          final dokter =
                              (data['dokter'] ?? '-').toString();

                          final status =
                              (data['status'] ?? 'Menunggu').toString();

                          return Card(
                            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 15),
                            elevation: 2,

                            color: Colors.white,

                            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
                              side: BorderSide(
                                color: Colors.blue.shade50,

                            ),

                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),

                              child: Column(
                                crossAxisAlignment:
                                    CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                                children: [
                                  // Nomor antrean dan status
                                  Row(
                                    crossAxisAlignment:
                                        CrossAxisAlignment.start,

                                    children: [
                                      Expanded(
                                        child: Text(
                                          nomorAntrean,
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            fontSize: 28,
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                            color: Colors.blue,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ),

                                      const SizedBox(width: 8),

                                      _buildStatus(status),
                                    ],
                                  ),

                                  const Divider(height: 26),

                                  // Informasi poli
                                  Row(
                                    children: [
                                      const Icon(
                                        Icons.local_hospital,

                                        size: 22,
                                      ),

  // ============================================================
  // TAMPILAN KETIKA DATA KOSONG
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildEmptyState({
    required IconData icon,
    required String judul,
    required String deskripsi,
  }) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(24),

        child: Column(
          mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
          children: [
            Icon(
              icon,
              size: 70,
              color: Colors.grey.shade400,
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 15),

            Text(
              judul,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 18,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),

            const SizedBox(height: 6),

            Text(
              deskripsi,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.grey),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TAMPILAN STATUS
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildStatus(String status) {
    Color warna;
    IconData icon;

    switch (status) {
      case 'Dipanggil':
        warna = Colors.orange;
        icon = Icons.volume_up;
        break;

      case 'Selesai':
        warna = Colors.green;
        icon = Icons.check_circle;
        break;

      case 'Dibatalkan':
        warna = Colors.red;
        icon = Icons.cancel;
        break;

      default:
        warna = Colors.blue;
        icon = Icons.access_time;
    }

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
        horizontal: 12,
        vertical: 7,
      ),

      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: warna.withValues(alpha: 0.1),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),

      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 16, color: warna),

          const SizedBox(width: 5),

          Text(
            status,
            style: TextStyle(
              color: warna,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TOMBOL AKSI ANTREAN
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildActionButton(
    BuildContext context,
    String documentId,
    String status,
  ) {
    // Menunggu -> Panggil
    if (status == 'Menunggu') {
      return SizedBox(
        width: double.infinity,

        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
          onPressed: () async {
            try {
              await AntreanService.panggilAntrean(documentId);

              if (!context.mounted) return;

              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                const SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Antrean berhasil dipanggil.'),
                ),
              );
            } catch (e) {
              if (!context.mounted) return;

              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Gagal memanggil antrean: $e'),
                ),
              );
            }
          },

          icon: const Icon(Icons.volume_up),
          label: const Text('Panggil Antrean'),

          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Dipanggil -> Selesaikan
    if (status == 'Dipanggil') {
      return SizedBox(
        width: double.infinity,

        child: ElevatedButton.icon(
          onPressed: () async {
            try {
              await AntreanService.selesaikanAntrean(documentId);

              if (!context.mounted) return;

              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                const SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Antrean berhasil diselesaikan.'),
                ),
              );
            } catch (e) {
              if (!context.mounted) return;

              ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
                SnackBar(
                  content: Text('Gagal menyelesaikan antrean: $e'),
                ),
              );
            }
          },

          icon: const Icon(Icons.check),
          label: const Text('Selesaikan Antrean'),

          style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
            backgroundColor: Colors.green,
            foregroundColor: Colors.white,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 14),
          ),
        ),
      );
    }

    // Selesai atau dibatalkan
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(vertical: 12),
      alignment: Alignment.center,

      child: Text(
        status == 'Selesai'
            ? 'Antrean selesai dilayani'
            : status == 'Dibatalkan'
                ? 'Antrean dibatalkan'
                : 'Tidak ada aksi tersedia',

        style: const TextStyle(
          color: Colors.grey,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../services/database_service.dart';

class AdminDashboardPage extends StatelessWidget {
  const AdminDashboardPage({super.key});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;

    if (user == null) {
      return _halamanPesan('Silakan login terlebih dahulu.');
    }

    // Pastikan yang membuka halaman adalah petugas.
    return FutureBuilder<String>(
      future: DatabaseService.ambilRole(user.uid),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
          return const Scaffold(
            body: Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator()),
          );
        }

        if (snapshot.data != 'petugas') {
          return _halamanPesan(
            'Akses ditolak. Halaman ini hanya untuk petugas.',
          );
        }

        return const _IsiDashboard();
      },
    );
  }

  Widget _halamanPesan(String pesan) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(title: const Text('Dashboard Statistik')),
      body: Center(child: Text(pesan)),
    );
  }
}

class _IsiDashboard extends StatelessWidget {
  const _IsiDashboard();

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF4F7FC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Dashboard Statistik',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
      ),
      body: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
        stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
            .collection('users')
            .where('role', isEqualTo: 'pasien')
            .snapshots(),
        builder: (context, pasienSnapshot) {
          if (pasienSnapshot.hasError) {
            return const Center(
              child: Text('Gagal mengambil data pasien dari Firebase.'),
            );
          }

          if (!pasienSnapshot.hasData) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final pasienDocs = pasienSnapshot.data!.docs;

          // UID pasien digunakan untuk mencari nama pasien.
          final namaPasien = <String, String>{
            for (final doc in pasienDocs)
              doc.id: (doc.data()['nama'] ?? 'Pasien').toString(),
          };

          return StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
            stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
                .collection('antrean')
                .snapshots(),
            builder: (context, antreanSnapshot) {
              if (antreanSnapshot.hasError) {
                return const Center(
                  child: Text('Gagal mengambil data antrean dari Firebase.'),
                );
              }

              if (!antreanSnapshot.hasData) {
                return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
              }

              final docs = antreanSnapshot.data!.docs;
              final dataAntrean = docs.map((doc) => doc.data()).toList();

              int jumlahStatus(String status) {
                return dataAntrean
                    .where((data) => data['status'] == status)
                    .length;
              }

              final menunggu = jumlahStatus('Menunggu');
              final dipanggil = jumlahStatus('Dipanggil');
              final selesai = jumlahStatus('Selesai');
              final dibatalkan = jumlahStatus('Dibatalkan');

              final sekarang = DateTime.now();

              // Menghitung antrean yang dibuat hari ini.
              final antreanHariIni = dataAntrean.where((data) {
                final waktu = _ubahTanggal(data['waktuAmbil']);

                return waktu != null &&
                    waktu.year == sekarang.year &&
                    waktu.month == sekarang.month &&
                    waktu.day == sekarang.day;
              }).length;

              // Menghitung jumlah antrean untuk setiap poli.
              final statistikPoli = <String, int>{};

              for (final data in dataAntrean) {
                final poli =
                    (data['namaPoli'] ?? 'Poli tidak diketahui').toString();

                statistikPoli[poli] = (statistikPoli[poli] ?? 0) + 1;
              }

              final daftarPoli = statistikPoli.entries.toList()
                ..sort((a, b) => b.value.compareTo(a.value));

              // Mengurutkan antrean dari yang terbaru.
              final antreanTerbaru = [...docs];

              antreanTerbaru.sort((a, b) {
                final waktuA =
                    _ubahTanggal(a.data()['waktuAmbil']) ?? DateTime(2000);

                final waktuB =
                    _ubahTanggal(b.data()['waktuAmbil']) ?? DateTime(2000);

                return waktuB.compareTo(waktuA);
              });

              return ListView(
                padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
                children: [
                  const Text(
                    'Ringkasan Klinik',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 24,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 6),
                  const Text(
                    'Data statistik diperbarui otomatis dari Firebase.',
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 18),

                  // KARTU STATISTIK
                  LayoutBuilder(
                    builder: (context, constraints) {
                      final kolom = constraints.maxWidth >= 850
                          ? 4
                          : constraints.maxWidth >= 520
                              ? 3
                              : 2;

                      return GridView.count(
                        crossAxisCount: kolom,
                        shrinkWrap: true,
                        physics: const NeverScrollableScrollPhysics(),
                        crossAxisSpacing: 12,
                        mainAxisSpacing: 12,
                        childAspectRatio: 1.35,
                        children: [
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Total Pasien',
                            nilai: pasienDocs.length,
                            ikon: Icons.people_alt_outlined,
                            warna: Colors.blue,
                          ),
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Total Antrean',
                            nilai: docs.length,
                            ikon: Icons.confirmation_num_outlined,
                            warna: Colors.deepPurple,
                          ),
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Menunggu',
                            nilai: menunggu,
                            ikon: Icons.hourglass_top,
                            warna: Colors.orange,
                          ),
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Dipanggil',
                            nilai: dipanggil,
                            ikon: Icons.campaign_outlined,
                            warna: Colors.teal,
                          ),
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Selesai',
                            nilai: selesai,
                            ikon: Icons.check_circle_outline,
                            warna: Colors.green,
                          ),
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Dibatalkan',
                            nilai: dibatalkan,
                            ikon: Icons.cancel_outlined,
                            warna: Colors.red,
                          ),
                          _KartuStatistik(
                            judul: 'Antrean Hari Ini',
                            nilai: antreanHariIni,
                            ikon: Icons.today_outlined,
                            warna: Colors.indigo,
                          ),
                        ],
                      );
                    },
                  ),

                  const SizedBox(height: 28),

                  // GRAFIK SEDERHANA PER POLI
                  const Text(
                    'Statistik Antrean per Poli',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  _Panel(
                    child: daftarPoli.isEmpty
                        ? const Text('Belum ada data antrean.')
                        : Column(
                            children: daftarPoli.map((item) {
                              final maksimum = daftarPoli
                                  .map((e) => e.value)
                                  .reduce((a, b) => a > b ? a : b);

                              final progress = maksimum == 0
                                  ? 0.0
                                  : item.value / maksimum;

                              return Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 18),
                                child: Column(
                                  crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                                  children: [
                                    Row(
                                      children: [
                                        Expanded(child: Text(item.key)),
                                        Text(
                                          '${item.value} antrean',
                                          style: const TextStyle(
                                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                          ),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ),
                                    const SizedBox(height: 8),
                                    ClipRRect(
                                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                                      child: LinearProgressIndicator(
                                        value: progress,
                                        minHeight: 12,
                                        backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade50,
                                        color: Colors.blue,
                                      ),
                                    ),
                                  ],
                                ),
                              );
                            }).toList(),
                          ),
                  ),

                  const SizedBox(height: 28),

                  // DAFTAR ANTREAN TERBARU
                  const Text(
                    'Antrean Terbaru',
                    style: TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 20,
                      fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    ),
                  ),
                  const SizedBox(height: 12),

                  if (antreanTerbaru.isEmpty)
                    const _Panel(
                      child: Text('Belum ada antrean yang tercatat.'),
                    ),

                  ...antreanTerbaru.take(10).map((doc) {
                    final data = doc.data();

                    final nomor =
                        (data['nomorAntrean'] ?? '-').toString();

                    final poli = (data['namaPoli'] ?? '-').toString();
                    final dokter = (data['dokter'] ?? '-').toString();
                    final status =
                        (data['status'] ?? 'Menunggu').toString();

                    final uid = (data['uid'] ?? '').toString();
                    final nama = namaPasien[uid] ?? 'Pasien';

                    final waktu = _ubahTanggal(data['waktuAmbil']);

                    return Card(
                      color: Colors.white,
                      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 10),
                      child: ListTile(
                        leading: CircleAvatar(
                          backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade50,
                          child: FittedBox(
                            child: Text(
                              nomor,
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                color: Colors.blue,
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        title: Text(
                          nama,
                          style: const TextStyle(
                            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                          ),
                        ),
                        subtitle: Text(
                          '$poli â€¢ $dokter\n${_formatTanggal(waktu)}',
                        ),
                        isThreeLine: true,
                        trailing: _LabelStatus(status: status),
                      ),
                    );
                  }),
                ],
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  static DateTime? _ubahTanggal(dynamic nilai) {
    if (nilai is Timestamp) return nilai.toDate();
    if (nilai is DateTime) return nilai;
    if (nilai is String) return DateTime.tryParse(nilai);
    return null;
  }

  static String _formatTanggal(DateTime? waktu) {
    if (waktu == null) return 'Waktu tidak tersedia';

    final tanggal = waktu.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final bulan = waktu.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final jam = waktu.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0');
    final menit = waktu.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0');

    return '$tanggal/$bulan/${waktu.year} â€¢ $jam:$menit';
  }
}

class _KartuStatistik extends StatelessWidget {

          ),
        ],

      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.spaceBetween,
        children: [

          Text(
            '$nilai',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontSize: 27,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              color: warna,
            ),
          ),
          Text(
            judul,
            maxLines: 2,
            overflow: TextOverflow.ellipsis,
            style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.black54),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// PANEL PUTIH UNTUK MEMBUNGKUS KONTEN
class _Panel extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Panel({required this.child});

  final Widget child;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Container(
      width: double.infinity,
      padding: const EdgeInsets.all(16),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: Colors.white,
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
      ),
      child: child,
    );
  }
}

// LABEL STATUS ANTREAN
class _LabelStatus extends StatelessWidget {
  const _LabelStatus({required this.status});

  final String status;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Color warna;

    switch (status) {
      case 'Menunggu':
        warna = Colors.orange;
        break;
      case 'Dipanggil':
        warna = Colors.blue;
        break;
      case 'Selesai':
        warna = Colors.green;
        break;
      case 'Dibatalkan':
        warna = Colors.red;
        break;
      default:
        warna = Colors.grey;
    }

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 9, vertical: 7),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: warna.withValues(alpha: 0.12),
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),
      child: Text(
        status,
        style: TextStyle(
          color: warna,
          fontSize: 11,
          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
        ),
      ),
    );
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

// ==========================================================
// ADMIN DATA PASIEN PAGE

class AdminDataPasienPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const AdminDataPasienPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<AdminDataPasienPage> createState() => _AdminDataPasienPageState();
}

class _AdminDataPasienPageState extends State<AdminDataPasienPage> {
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();

  String _kataKunci = '';
  String _filterJenisKelamin = 'Semua';

  final List<String> _pilihanJenisKelamin = [
    'Semua',
    'Laki-laki',
    'Perempuan',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // FILTER DATA PASIEN
  // ==========================================================

  bool _cocokDenganPencarian(Map<String, dynamic> data) {
    final nama = (data['nama'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final email = (data['email'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final telepon =
        (data['nomorTelepon'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final alamat = (data['alamat'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();
    final jenisKelamin =
        (data['jenisKelamin'] ?? '').toString().toLowerCase();

    final cocokKataKunci = nama.contains(_kataKunci) ||
        email.contains(_kataKunci) ||
        telepon.contains(_kataKunci) ||
        alamat.contains(_kataKunci);

    final filter = _filterJenisKelamin.toLowerCase();

    final cocokJenisKelamin = _filterJenisKelamin == 'Semua' ||
        jenisKelamin == filter;

    return cocokKataKunci && cocokJenisKelamin;
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // BUILD HALAMAN
  // ==========================================================

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF5F9FF),

      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Data Pasien',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        backgroundColor: Colors.blue,
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        elevation: 0,
      ),

      body: Column(
        children: [
          // ====================================================
          // HEADER DAN PENCARIAN
          // ====================================================

          Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(18, 18, 18, 22),

            decoration: const BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.blue,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.vertical(
                bottom: Radius.circular(24),
              ),
            ),

            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Kelola Data Pasien',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontSize: 20,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 5),

                const Text(
                  'Cari dan lihat informasi pasien terdaftar.',
                  style: TextStyle(color: Colors.white70),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 16),

                // Kolom pencarian
                TextField(
                  controller: _searchController,
                  focusNode: _searchFocusNode,

                  onChanged: (value) {
                    setState(() {
                      _kataKunci = value.trim().toLowerCase();
                    });
                  },

                  decoration: InputDecoration(
                    hintText: 'Cari nama, email, telepon, alamat...',
                    hintStyle: TextStyle(
                      color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                      fontSize: 13,
                    ),

                    prefixIcon: const Icon(
                      Icons.search,
                      color: Colors.blue,
                    ),

                    suffixIcon: _kataKunci.isNotEmpty
                        ? IconButton(
                            tooltip: 'Hapus pencarian',
                            icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                            onPressed: () {
                              _searchController.clear();

                              setState(() {
                                _kataKunci = '';
                              });

                              _searchFocusNode.requestFocus();
                            },
                          )
                        : null,

                    filled: true,
                    fillColor: Colors.white,

                    contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                      horizontal: 16,
                      vertical: 15,
                    ),

                    border: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,
                    ),

                    enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                      borderSide: BorderSide.none,

                    focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
                      borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),

                      ),
                    ),
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 14),

                const Text(
                  'Jenis Kelamin',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.white,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
                  ),
                ),

                const SizedBox(height: 8),

                // Filter jenis kelamin
                SingleChildScrollView(

                  child: Row(
                    children: _pilihanJenisKelamin.map((jenis) {
                      final terpilih = _filterJenisKelamin == jenis;

                      return Padding(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),

                        child: ChoiceChip(
                          label: Text(jenis),
                          selected: terpilih,

                          onSelected: (selected) {
                            if (selected) {
                              setState(() {
                                _filterJenisKelamin = jenis;
                              });
                            }
                          },

                          selectedColor: Colors.white,
                          backgroundColor: Colors.blue.shade400,

                          labelStyle: TextStyle(
                            color: terpilih
                                ? Colors.blue.shade800

                          side: BorderSide(

          // ====================================================

          Expanded(

                  .collection('users')
                  .where('role', isEqualTo: 'pasien')
                  .snapshots(),

              builder: (context, snapshot) {

                    ConnectionState.waiting) {
                  return const Center(

                if (snapshot.hasError) {

                if (!snapshot.hasData ||
                    snapshot.data!.docs.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildEmptyState(
                    icon: Icons.people_outline,
                    judul: 'Belum ada data pasien',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Data pasien yang terdaftar akan muncul di sini.',
                  );
                }

                final semuaPasien = snapshot.data!.docs;

                // Filter dilakukan di sisi aplikasi.
                // Controller pencarian tetap berada di luar StreamBuilder.
                final pasien = semuaPasien.where((document) {
                  final data =
                      document.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

                  return _cocokDenganPencarian(data);
                }).toList();

                if (pasien.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildEmptyState(
                    icon: Icons.person_search,
                    judul: 'Pasien tidak ditemukan',
                    deskripsi:

                      ),

                      child: Row(

                          const Icon(

                            color: Colors.blue,
                          ),

                          const SizedBox(width: 8),

                          Expanded(
                            child: Text(
                              '${pasien.length} pasien ditemukan',
                              style: const TextStyle(
                                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                                fontSize: 15,
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                      ),
                    ),

                    // Daftar kartu pasien
                    Expanded(
                      child: ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(20),

                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final document = pasien[index];

      context: context,
      builder: (dialogContext) {
        return AlertDialog(
          title: const Text(
            'Logout',
            style: TextStyle(
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            ),
          ),

          content: const Text(
            'Apakah Anda yakin ingin keluar dari akun petugas?',
          ),

          actions: [
            // TOMBOL BATAL

            TextButton(
              onPressed: () {
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);
              },
              child: const Text('Batal'),
            ),

            // TOMBOL LOGOUT

            ElevatedButton(
              onPressed: () async {
                // Tutup dialog
                Navigator.pop(dialogContext);

                // Logout dari Firebase Authentication
                await FirebaseAuth.instance.signOut();

                // Kembali ke halaman login
                if (context.mounted) {
                  Navigator.pushAndRemoveUntil(
                    context,
                    MaterialPageRoute(
                      builder: (context) => const LoginPage(),
                    ),
                    (route) => false,
                  );
                }
              },
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: Colors.red,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
              ),
              child: const Text('Logout'),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
