import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

import '../services/antrean_service.dart';
import '../services/notification_service.dart';
import '../widgets/status_badge.dart';
import 'penilaian_layanan_page.dart';

class RiwayatAntreanPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const RiwayatAntreanPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<RiwayatAntreanPage> createState() =>
      _RiwayatAntreanPageState();
}

class _RiwayatAntreanPageState
    extends State<RiwayatAntreanPage> {
  final Map<String, String> _statusSebelumnya = {};
  final Set<String> _notifikasiSudahDikirim = {};

  bool _sedangMemeriksaStatus = false;

  // Dibuat sekali dan dipertahankan selama halaman aktif.
  final TextEditingController _searchController =
      TextEditingController();

  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();

  String _kataKunci = '';
  String _filterStatus = 'Semua';

  final List<String> _daftarFilter = [
    'Semua',
    'Menunggu',
    'Dipanggil',
    'Selesai',
    'Dibatalkan',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // NOTIFIKASI PERUBAHAN STATUS
  // ============================================================

  Future<void> _cekPerubahanStatus(
    List<QueryDocumentSnapshot> documents,
  ) async {
    if (_sedangMemeriksaStatus) return;

    _sedangMemeriksaStatus = true;

    try {
      for (final document in documents) {
        final Map<String, dynamic> antrean =
            document.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

        final String statusSekarang =
            antrean['status']?.toString() ?? 'Menunggu';

        final String? statusLama =
            _statusSebelumnya[document.id];

        if (statusLama == null) {
          _statusSebelumnya[document.id] = statusSekarang;
          continue;
        }

        if (statusLama != 'Dipanggil' &&
            statusSekarang == 'Dipanggil' &&
            !_notifikasiSudahDikirim.contains(document.id)) {
          _notifikasiSudahDikirim.add(document.id);

          await NotificationService
              .tampilkanNotifikasiGiliranAnda(
            nomorAntrean:
                antrean['nomorAntrean']?.toString() ?? '-',
            namaPoli:
                antrean['namaPoli']?.toString() ?? '-',
            dokter:
                antrean['dokter']?.toString() ?? '-',
          );
        }

        _statusSebelumnya[document.id] = statusSekarang;
      }
    } catch (e) {
      debugPrint('Gagal memeriksa status antrean: $e');
    } finally {
      _sedangMemeriksaStatus = false;
    }
  }

  // ============================================================
  // PENILAIAN LAYANAN
  // ============================================================

  Future<void> _bukaPenilaian({
    required String idAntrean,
    required String namaPoli,
    required String dokter,
  }) async {
    final User? user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;

    if (user == null) {
      if (!mounted) return;
      _tampilkanPesan('Silakan login terlebih dahulu.');
      return;
    }

    try {
      final antreanDoc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('antrean')
          .doc(idAntrean)
          .get();

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (!antreanDoc.exists) {
        _tampilkanPesan('Data antrean tidak ditemukan.');
        return;
      }

      final dataAntrean = antreanDoc.data()!;

      if (dataAntrean['uid'] != user.uid) {
        _tampilkanPesan(
          'Anda tidak memiliki akses ke antrean ini.',
        );
        return;
      }

      if (dataAntrean['status'] != 'Selesai') {
        _tampilkanPesan(
          'Penilaian hanya tersedia setelah pelayanan selesai.',
        );
        return;
      }

      final penilaianDoc = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('penilaian_layanan')
          .doc(idAntrean)
          .get();

      if (!mounted) return;

      if (penilaianDoc.exists) {
        _tampilkanPesan('Antrean ini sudah Anda nilai.');
        return;
      }

      await Navigator.push(
        context,
        MaterialPageRoute(
          builder: (context) => PenilaianLayananPage(
            idAntrean: idAntrean,
            namaPoli: namaPoli,
            dokter: dokter,
          ),
        ),
      );
    } catch (e) {
      if (!mounted) return;

      _tampilkanPesan('Gagal membuka penilaian: $e');
    }
  }

  void _tampilkanPesan(String pesan) {
    ScaffoldMessenger.of(context).showSnackBar(
      SnackBar(content: Text(pesan)),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildTombolPenilaian({
    required String idAntrean,
    required String namaPoli,
    required String dokter,
    required String status,
  }) {
    if (status != 'Selesai') {
      return const SizedBox.shrink();
    }

    return StreamBuilder<DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>(
      stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .collection('penilaian_layanan')
          .doc(idAntrean)
          .snapshots(),
      builder: (context, snapshot) {
        if (snapshot.connectionState ==
            ConnectionState.waiting) {
          return const Padding(
            padding: EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
            child: LinearProgressIndicator(),
          );
        }

        if (snapshot.hasError) {
          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
            child: Text(
              'Status penilaian tidak dapat dimuat.',
              style: TextStyle(
                color: Colors.red.shade700,
                fontSize: 12,
              ),
            ),
          );
        }

        if (snapshot.data?.exists ?? false) {
          return Container(
            width: double.infinity,
            margin: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
              horizontal: 14,
              vertical: 13,
            ),
            decoration: BoxDecoration(
              color: Colors.green.shade50,
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
              border: Border.all(
                color: Colors.green.shade200,
              ),
            ),
            child: Row(
              mainAxisAlignment: MainAxisAlignment.center,
              children: [
                Icon(
                  Icons.check_circle,
                  color: Colors.green.shade700,
                  size: 20,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Text(
                  'Penilaian Terkirim',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    color: Colors.green.shade800,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
          );
        }

        return Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 12),
          child: SizedBox(
            width: double.infinity,
            child: ElevatedButton.icon(
              onPressed: () => _bukaPenilaian(
                idAntrean: idAntrean,
                namaPoli: namaPoli,
                dokter: dokter,
              ),
              icon: const Icon(Icons.star_outline),
              label: const Text('Beri Penilaian'),
              style: ElevatedButton.styleFrom(
                backgroundColor: Colors.orange.shade700,
                foregroundColor: Colors.white,
                padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
                  vertical: 13,
                ),
                shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                  borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(12),
                ),
              ),
            ),
          ),
        );
      },
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SEARCH BAR
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildSearchBar() {
    return TextField(
      key: const ValueKey('search_riwayat_antrean'),
      controller: _searchController,
      focusNode: _searchFocusNode,
      textInputAction: TextInputAction.search,
      onChanged: (value) {
        // Perubahan kata kunci tidak membuat controller baru.
        setState(() {
          _kataKunci = value.toLowerCase();
        });
      },
      decoration: InputDecoration(
        hintText: 'Cari nomor, poli, atau dokter...',
        prefixIcon: const Icon(
          Icons.search,
          color: Color(0xFF0875BD),
        ),
        suffixIcon: _kataKunci.isNotEmpty
            ? IconButton(
                tooltip: 'Hapus pencarian',
                icon: const Icon(Icons.close),
                onPressed: () {
                  _searchController.clear();

                  setState(() {
                    _kataKunci = '';
                  });

                  _searchFocusNode.requestFocus();
                },
              )
            : null,
        filled: true,
        fillColor: Colors.white,
        contentPadding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: 16,
          vertical: 15,
        ),
        border: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: BorderSide.none,
        ),
        enabledBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: BorderSide(
            color: Colors.grey.shade200,
          ),
        ),
        focusedBorder: OutlineInputBorder(
          borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(16),
          borderSide: const BorderSide(
            color: Color(0xFF0875BD),
            width: 1.5,
          ),
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // FILTER STATUS
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildFilterStatus() {
    return SingleChildScrollView(
      scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
      child: Row(
        children: _daftarFilter.map((filter) {
          final bool terpilih = _filterStatus == filter;

          return Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
            child: ChoiceChip(
              label: Text(filter),
              selected: terpilih,
              showCheckmark: false,
              selectedColor: const Color(0xFF0875BD),
              backgroundColor: Colors.white,
              labelStyle: TextStyle(
                color: terpilih
                    ? Colors.white
                    : Colors.black87,
                fontWeight: terpilih
                    ? FontWeight.bold
                    : FontWeight.normal,
              ),
              side: BorderSide(
                color: terpilih
                    ? const Color(0xFF0875BD)
                    : Colors.grey.shade300,
              ),
              shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(24),
              ),
              onSelected: (_) {
                setState(() {
                  _filterStatus = filter;
                });
              },
            ),
          );
        }).toList(),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // FILTER DATA
  // ============================================================

  bool _cocokDenganPencarian(
    Map<String, dynamic> antrean,
  ) {
    final String nomor =
        antrean['nomorAntrean']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';

    final String namaPoli =
        antrean['namaPoli']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';

    final String dokter =
        antrean['dokter']?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? '';

    final String status =
        antrean['status']?.toString() ?? 'Menunggu';

    final String kataKunci = _kataKunci.trim();

    final bool cocokKataKunci = kataKunci.isEmpty ||
        nomor.contains(kataKunci) ||
        namaPoli.contains(kataKunci) ||
        dokter.contains(kataKunci);

    final bool cocokStatus =
        _filterStatus == 'Semua' ||
        status == _filterStatus;

    return cocokKataKunci && cocokStatus;
  }

  // ============================================================
  // TAMPILAN KOSONG
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildKosong({
    required IconData icon,
    required String judul,
    required String deskripsi,
  }) {
    return Center(
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(28),
        child: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          children: [
            Icon(
              icon,
              size: 72,
              color: Colors.grey.shade400,
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            Text(
              judul,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                fontSize: 19,
                fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              ),
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 8),
            Text(
              deskripsi,
              textAlign: TextAlign.center,
              style: const TextStyle(
                color: Colors.grey,
                height: 1.5,
              ),
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),

  // ============================================================
  // BUILD
  // ============================================================

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final User? user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;

    if (user == null) {
      return Scaffold(
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text('Riwayat Antrean'),
        ),
        body: const Center(
          child: Text('Silakan login terlebih dahulu.'),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF4F8FC),
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: const Text(
          'Riwayat Antrean',
          style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
        ),
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xFFF4F8FC),
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          // Search dan filter berada di luar StreamBuilder.
          // Perubahan data Firestore tidak mengganti widget
          // pencarian yang sedang menerima input.
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
              16, 16, 16, 8,
            ),
            child: Column(
              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
              children: [
                _buildSearchBar(),
                const SizedBox(height: 14),
                _buildFilterStatus(),
              ],
            ),
          ),

          Expanded(
            child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
              stream: AntreanService
                  .riwayatAntreanPasien(user.uid),
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.connectionState ==
                        ConnectionState.waiting &&
                    !snapshot.hasData) {
                  return const Center(
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(),
                  );
                }

                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return _buildKosong(
                    icon: Icons.error_outline,
                    judul: 'Gagal Memuat Riwayat',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Terjadi kesalahan saat mengambil data antrean.',
                  );
                }

                if (!snapshot.hasData ||
                    snapshot.data!.docs.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildKosong(
                    icon: Icons.history,
                    judul: 'Belum Ada Riwayat Antrean',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Antrean yang pernah Anda ambil akan muncul '
                        'di halaman ini.',
                  );
                }

                final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot> daftarRiwayat =
                    snapshot.data!.docs;

                // Periksa status setelah frame selesai.
                WidgetsBinding.instance.addPostFrameCallback((_) {
                  if (mounted) {
                    _cekPerubahanStatus(daftarRiwayat);
                  }
                });

                final List<QueryDocumentSnapshot> hasilFilter =
                    daftarRiwayat.where((document) {
                  final data =
                      document.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

                  return _cocokDenganPencarian(data);
                }).toList();

                if (hasilFilter.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildKosong(
                    icon: Icons.search_off,
                    judul: 'Data Tidak Ditemukan',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Coba kata kunci lain atau ubah filter status.',
                  );
                }

                return Column(
                  children: [
                    Padding(
                      padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                        18, 4, 18, 10,
                      ),
                      child: Align(
                        alignment: Alignment.centerLeft,
                        child: Text(
                          '${hasilFilter.length} riwayat ditemukan',
                          style: TextStyle(
                            color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                            fontSize: 13,
                          ),
                        ),
                      ),
                    ),
                    Expanded(
                      child: ListView.builder(
                        padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                          16, 0, 16, 20,
                        ),
                        keyboardDismissBehavior:
                            ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
                        itemCount: hasilFilter.length,
                        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                          final document = hasilFilter[index];

                          final Map<String, dynamic> antrean =
                              document.data()
                                  as Map<String, dynamic>;

                          return _buildRiwayatCard(
                            idAntrean: document.id,
                            antrean: antrean,
                          );
                        },
                      ),
                    ),
                  ],
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  // ============================================================
  // KARTU RIWAYAT
  // ============================================================

  Widget _buildRiwayatCard({
    required String idAntrean,
    required Map<String, dynamic> antrean,
  }) {
    final String nomor =
        antrean['nomorAntrean']?.toString() ?? '-';

    final String namaPoli =
        antrean['namaPoli']?.toString() ?? '-';

    final String dokter =
        antrean['dokter']?.toString() ?? '-';

    final String status =
        antrean['status']?.toString() ?? 'Menunggu';

    String waktu = 'Waktu tidak tersedia';

    final dynamic waktuAmbil = antrean['waktuAmbil'];

    if (waktuAmbil is Timestamp) {
      final DateTime tanggal = waktuAmbil.toDate();

      waktu =
          '${tanggal.day.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/'
          '${tanggal.month.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}/'
          '${tanggal.year} '
          '${tanggal.hour.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}:'
          '${tanggal.minute.toString().padLeft(2, '0')}';
    }

    return Card(
      elevation: 2,
      color: Colors.white,
      margin: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 14),
      shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(18),
        side: BorderSide(color: Colors.grey.shade100),
      ),
      child: Padding(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.all(18),
        child: Column(
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
          children: [
            Row(
              children: [
                Container(
                  width: 50,
                  height: 50,
                  decoration: BoxDecoration(
                    color: const Color(0xFFE5F2FF),
                    borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(14),
                  ),
                  child: const Icon(
                    Icons.confirmation_number,
                    color: Color(0xFF0875BD),
                    size: 27,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 12),
                Expanded(
                  child: Column(
                    crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                    children: [
                      Text(
                        namaPoli,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 17,
                          fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                        ),
                      ),
                      const SizedBox(height: 4),
                      Text(
                        dokter,
                        style: const TextStyle(
                          fontSize: 13,
                          color: Colors.grey,
                        ),
                      ),
                    ],
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 6),
                Text(
                  nomor,
                  style: const TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 20,
                    fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
                    color: Color(0xFF0875BD),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 18),
            Divider(color: Colors.grey.shade200),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                Icon(
                  Icons.calendar_today,
                  size: 18,
                  color: Colors.grey.shade600,
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                Expanded(
                  child: Text(
                    waktu,
                    style: const TextStyle(
                      fontSize: 14,
                      color: Colors.grey,
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Row(
              children: [
                const Text(
                  'Status:',
                  style: TextStyle(
                    fontSize: 14,
                    color: Colors.grey,
                  ),
                ),
                const SizedBox(width: 8),
                StatusBadge(status: status),
              ],
            ),
            const SizedBox(height: 12),
            Container(
              width: double.infinity,
              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(12),
              decoration: BoxDecoration(
                color: const Color(0xFFF4F8FC),
                borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(10),
              ),
              child: Text(
                _getKeteranganStatus(status),
                style: const TextStyle(
                  fontSize: 13,
                  color: Colors.grey,
                  height: 1.4,
                ),
              ),
            ),
            _buildTombolPenilaian(
              idAntrean: idAntrean,
              namaPoli: namaPoli,
              dokter: dokter,
              status: status,
            ),
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  String _getKeteranganStatus(String status) {
    switch (status) {
      case 'Menunggu':
        return 'Antrean Anda sedang menunggu dipanggil oleh petugas.';
      case 'Dipanggil':
        return 'Nomor antrean Anda sedang dilayani oleh petugas.';
      case 'Selesai':
        return 'Antrean Anda telah selesai dilayani. '
            'Silakan berikan penilaian terhadap layanan klinik.';
      case 'Dibatalkan':
        return 'Antrean ini telah dibatalkan.';
      default:
        return 'Status antrean tidak diketahui.';
    }
  }
}

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

import '../services/konsultasi_service.dart';
import 'detail_konsultasi_page.dart';

class RiwayatKonsultasiPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const RiwayatKonsultasiPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<RiwayatKonsultasiPage> createState() =>
      _RiwayatKonsultasiPageState();
}

class _RiwayatKonsultasiPageState extends State<RiwayatKonsultasiPage> {
  // Controller dan FocusNode dibuat sekali agar pencarian tetap stabil.
  final TextEditingController _searchController = TextEditingController();
  final FocusNode _searchFocusNode = FocusNode();

  String _kataKunci = '';
  String _filterStatus = 'Semua';

  final List<String> _daftarFilter = [
    'Semua',
    'Menunggu',
    'Dijadwalkan',
    'Selesai',
    'Dibatalkan',
  ];

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _searchController.dispose();
    _searchFocusNode.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final User? user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;

    if (user == null) {
      return Scaffold(
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xffF5F9FF),
        appBar: AppBar(
          title: const Text(
            'Riwayat Konsultasi',
            style: TextStyle(fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
          ),
        ),
        body: const Center(
          child: Text('Silakan login terlebih dahulu.'),
        ),
      );
    }

    return Scaffold(
      backgroundColor: const Color(0xffF5F9FF),
      appBar: AppBar(
        elevation: 0,
        backgroundColor: const Color(0xff1769AA),
        foregroundColor: Colors.white,
        title: const Text(
          'Riwayat Konsultasi',
          style: TextStyle(
            fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
            fontSize: 20,
          ),
        ),
      ),
      body: Column(
        children: [
          // Header dan pencarian berada di luar StreamBuilder.
          _buildHeader(),

          // Filter status.
          _buildFilterStatus(),

          // Hanya bagian daftar yang mengikuti perubahan Firestore.
          Expanded(
            child: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot>(
              stream: KonsultasiService.ambilRiwayatKonsultasi(user.uid),
              builder: (context, snapshot) {
                if (snapshot.connectionState == ConnectionState.waiting) {
                  return const Center(
                    child: CircularProgressIndicator(
                      color: Color(0xff1769AA),
                    ),
                  );
                }

                if (snapshot.hasError) {
                  return _buildPesan(
                    icon: Icons.error_outline,
                    judul: 'Gagal memuat riwayat',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Terjadi kesalahan saat mengambil data konsultasi. '
                        'Silakan coba lagi.',
                    warna: Colors.red,
                  );
                }

                if (!snapshot.hasData || snapshot.data!.docs.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildPesan(
                    icon: Icons.history,
                    judul: 'Belum Ada Riwayat',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Konsultasi yang Anda lakukan akan muncul '
                        'di halaman ini.',
                    warna: const Color(0xff1769AA),
                  );
                }

                final daftarDokumen = snapshot.data!.docs;

                // Pencarian dan filter dilakukan pada data yang diterima.
                final daftarKonsultasi = daftarDokumen.where((dokumen) {
                  final data = dokumen.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

                  final namaPasien =
                      (data['namaPasien'] ?? 'Pasien').toString();
                  final poli = (data['poli'] ?? 'Poli').toString();
                  final dokter = (data['dokter'] ?? 'Dokter').toString();
                  final tanggal = (data['tanggal'] ?? '-').toString();
                  final jam = (data['jam'] ?? '-').toString();
                  final keluhan = (data['keluhan'] ?? '-').toString();
                  final status = (data['status'] ?? 'Menunggu').toString();

                  final kataKunci = _kataKunci.trim().toLowerCase();

                  final cocokPencarian = kataKunci.isEmpty ||
                      namaPasien.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci) ||
                      poli.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci) ||
                      dokter.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci) ||
                      tanggal.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci) ||
                      jam.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci) ||
                      keluhan.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci) ||
                      status.toLowerCase().contains(kataKunci);

                  final cocokStatus = _filterStatus == 'Semua' ||
                      status.toLowerCase() == _filterStatus.toLowerCase();

                  return cocokPencarian && cocokStatus;
                }).toList();

                if (daftarKonsultasi.isEmpty) {
                  return _buildPesan(
                    icon: Icons.search_off,
                    judul: 'Konsultasi Tidak Ditemukan',
                    deskripsi:
                        'Coba kata kunci lain atau ubah filter status '
                        'yang sedang dipilih.',
                    warna: Colors.orange,
                    tombol: true,
                  );
                }

                return ListView.builder(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(16, 8, 16, 24),
                  keyboardDismissBehavior:
                      ScrollViewKeyboardDismissBehavior.onDrag,
                  itemCount: daftarKonsultasi.length,
                  itemBuilder: (context, index) {
                    final dokumen = daftarKonsultasi[index];
                    final data = dokumen.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

                    final documentId = dokumen.id;
                    final namaPasien =
                        (data['namaPasien'] ?? 'Pasien').toString();
                    final poli = (data['poli'] ?? 'Poli').toString();
                    final dokter = (data['dokter'] ?? 'Dokter').toString();
                    final tanggal = (data['tanggal'] ?? '-').toString();
                    final jam = (data['jam'] ?? '-').toString();
                    final keluhan = (data['keluhan'] ?? '-').toString();
                    final status = (data['status'] ?? 'Menunggu').toString();

                    return _buildKartuKonsultasi(
                      documentId: documentId,
                      namaPasien: namaPasien,
                      poli: poli,
                      dokter: dokter,
                      tanggal: tanggal,
                      jam: jam,
                      keluhan: keluhan,
                      status: status,
                    );
                  },
                );
              },
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  Widget _buildFilterStatus() {
    return SizedBox(
      height: 64,
      child: ListView.separated(
        padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(
          horizontal: 16,
          vertical: 14,
        ),
        scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,

        separatorBuilder: (_, _) => const SizedBox(width: 8),
        itemBuilder: (context, index) {
          final status = _daftarFilter[index];
          final terpilih = _filterStatus == status;

          return ChoiceChip(
            label: Text(status),
            selected: terpilih,
            showCheckmark: false,
            onSelected: (_) {
              setState(() {
                _filterStatus = status;
              });
            },
            backgroundColor: Colors.white,
            selectedColor: const Color(0xff1769AA),
            side: BorderSide(
              color: terpilih
                  ? const Color(0xff1769AA)
                  : Colors.grey.shade300,

            labelStyle: TextStyle(
              color: terpilih ? Colors.white : Colors.black87,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.w600,
              fontSize: 12,

            shape: RoundedRectangleBorder(
              borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),

    );

                    _filterStatus = 'Semua';
                  });
                },
                icon: const Icon(Icons.refresh),
                label: const Text('Reset pencarian'),
              ),
            ],
          ],
        ),
      ),
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // WARNA STATUS
  // ==========================================================

  Color _warnaStatus(String status) {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'menunggu':
        return const Color(0xff1976D2);
      case 'dijadwalkan':
        return const Color(0xffEF8C00);
      case 'selesai':
        return const Color(0xff218838);
      case 'dibatalkan':
        return const Color(0xffD32F2F);
      default:
        return Colors.blueGrey;
    }
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // IKON STATUS
  // ==========================================================

  IconData _ikonStatus(String status) {
    switch (status.toLowerCase()) {
      case 'menunggu':
        return Icons.schedule;
      case 'dijadwalkan':
        return Icons.event_available;
      case 'selesai':
        return Icons.check_circle_outline;
      case 'dibatalkan':
        return Icons.cancel_outlined;
      default:
        return Icons.info_outline;
    }
  }

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class AntreanService {
  // ============================================================
  // COLLECTION ANTREAN
  // ============================================================

  static final FirebaseFirestore firestore = FirebaseFirestore.instance;

  static final CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>>
      antreanCollection = firestore.collection('antrean');

  // Collection untuk menyimpan nomor antrean terakhir setiap poli.
  static final CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>>
      counterCollection = firestore.collection('counter_antrean');

  // ============================================================
  // AMBIL ANTREAN
  // ============================================================

  static Future<String> ambilAntrean({
    required String uid,
    required String namaPoli,
    required String dokter,
  }) async {
    // ID counter dibuat berdasarkan nama poli.
    // Setiap poli memiliki penghitung nomor masing-masing.
    final String counterId = Uri.encodeComponent(namaPoli);

    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> counterRef =
        counterCollection.doc(counterId);

    // Buat ID dokumen antrean sebelum transaksi.
    // ID ini tetap sama meskipun transaksi diulang oleh Firestore.
    final DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> antreanRef =
        antreanCollection.doc();

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // MEMERIKSA NOMOR ANTREAN YANG SUDAH ADA
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // Pemeriksaan ini membantu menyesuaikan counter dengan data
    // antrean lama yang mungkin sudah tersimpan di Firestore.
    //
    // Catatan: pengambilan nomor baru tetap dilakukan di dalam
    // transaksi agar permintaan bersamaan tidak memakai nomor sama.

    final QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snapshot =
        await antreanCollection
            .where('namaPoli', isEqualTo: namaPoli)
            .get();

    int nomorTerakhir = 0;

    for (final doc in snapshot.docs) {
      final String nomor = doc.data()['nomorAntrean']?.toString() ?? '';

      if (nomor.startsWith('A')) {
        final int angka = int.tryParse(nomor.substring(1)) ?? 0;

        if (angka > nomorTerakhir) {
          nomorTerakhir = angka;
        }
      }
    }

    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    // TRANSAKSI FIRESTORE
    // ----------------------------------------------------------
    //
    // Firestore mengatur transaksi yang mengubah counter yang sama.
    // Jika dua pasien mengambil antrean bersamaan, transaksi yang
    // bertabrakan akan dicoba kembali oleh Firestore.

    return await firestore.runTransaction<String>((transaction) async {
      // Baca counter nomor antrean poli.
      final DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> counterSnapshot =
          await transaction.get(counterRef);

      // Ambil nomor terakhir dari counter.
      final int nomorCounter =
          (counterSnapshot.data()?['nomorTerakhir'] as num?)?.toInt() ?? 0;

      // Bandingkan counter dengan data antrean yang sudah ada.
      final int nomorDasar = nomorCounter > nomorTerakhir
          ? nomorCounter
          : nomorTerakhir;

      // Buat nomor berikutnya.
      final int nomorBaru = nomorDasar + 1;

      final String nomorAntrean =
          'A${nomorBaru.toString().padLeft(3, '0')}';

      // Simpan nomor terakhir ke counter poli.
      transaction.set(counterRef, {
        'namaPoli': namaPoli,
        'nomorTerakhir': nomorBaru,
        'diperbaruiPada': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });

      // Simpan data antrean pasien.
      transaction.set(antreanRef, {
        'uid': uid,
        'nomorAntrean': nomorAntrean,
        'namaPoli': namaPoli,
        'dokter': dokter,
        'status': 'Menunggu',
        'waktuAmbil': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
        'waktuDipanggil': null,
        'waktuSelesai': null,
      });

      // Kembalikan nomor antrean yang berhasil dibuat.
      return nomorAntrean;
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // SEMUA ANTREAN PADA SATU POLI
  // ============================================================

  static Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> semuaAntreanPoli(
    String namaPoli,
  ) {
    return antreanCollection
        .where('namaPoli', isEqualTo: namaPoli)
        .snapshots();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ANTREAN PASIEN
  // ============================================================

  static Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> antreanPasien(
    String uid,
  ) {
    return antreanCollection.where('uid', isEqualTo: uid).snapshots();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // RIWAYAT ANTREAN PASIEN
  // ============================================================

  static Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> riwayatAntreanPasien(
    String uid,
  ) {
    return antreanCollection.where('uid', isEqualTo: uid).snapshots();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ANTREAN YANG SEDANG DIPANGGIL
  // ============================================================

  static Stream<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>> antreanSedangDilayani(
    String namaPoli,
  ) {
    return antreanCollection
        .where('namaPoli', isEqualTo: namaPoli)
        .where('status', isEqualTo: 'Dipanggil')
        .snapshots();
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ADMIN MEMANGGIL ANTREAN
  // ============================================================

  static Future<void> panggilAntrean(String documentId) async {
    await antreanCollection.doc(documentId).update({
      'status': 'Dipanggil',
      'waktuDipanggil': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // ADMIN MENYELESAIKAN ANTREAN
  // ============================================================

  static Future<void> selesaikanAntrean(String documentId) async {
    await antreanCollection.doc(documentId).update({
      'status': 'Selesai',
      'waktuSelesai': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // ============================================================
  // MEMBATALKAN ANTREAN
  // ============================================================

  static Future<void> batalkanAntrean(String documentId) async {
    await antreanCollection.doc(documentId).update({
      'status': 'Dibatalkan',
    });
  }
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

class DatabaseService {
  // ==========================================================
  // COLLECTION USERS
  // ==========================================================

  static final CollectionReference users = FirebaseFirestore.instance
      .collection('users');

  // ==========================================================
  // SIMPAN DATA USER
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<void> simpanUser({
    required String uid,
    required String nama,
    required String email,
  }) async {
    await users.doc(uid).set({
      'nama': nama,
      'email': email,

      // ======================================================
      // ROLE USER
      // ======================================================
      // Setiap user yang melakukan register dari aplikasi
      // akan otomatis menjadi pasien.
      'role': 'pasien',

      // ======================================================
      // DATA PROFIL LAINNYA
      // ======================================================

      'jenisKelamin': '',
      'tempatLahir': '',
      'tanggalLahir': '',
      'golonganDarah': '',
      'nomorTelepon': '',
      'alamat': '',
      'fotoProfil': '',

      // ======================================================
      // TOKEN FCM
      // ======================================================
      // Array ini digunakan untuk menyimpan token notifikasi
      // dari berbagai perangkat milik user.
      //
      // Contoh:
      // HP     -> token HP
      // Laptop -> token browser laptop
      //
      // Untuk user baru, array dibuat kosong terlebih dahulu.
      'fcmTokens': [],

      // ======================================================
      // WAKTU PEMBUATAN AKUN
      // ======================================================

      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // AMBIL DATA USER
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<DocumentSnapshot> ambilUser(String uid) async {
    return await users.doc(uid).get();
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // AMBIL ROLE USER
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<String> ambilRole(String uid) async {
    // Mengambil data user berdasarkan UID
    final DocumentSnapshot snapshot = await users.doc(uid).get();

    // Jika data user tidak ditemukan,
    // maka dianggap sebagai pasien.
    if (!snapshot.exists) {
      return 'pasien';
    }

    // Mengubah data Firestore menjadi Map
    final Map<String, dynamic> data =
        snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

    // Mengambil role dari Firestore.
    // Jika role belum ada, gunakan pasien
    // sebagai nilai default.
    return data['role'] ?? 'pasien';
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // SIMPAN TOKEN FCM
  // ==========================================================
  //
  // Token FCM digunakan Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM)
  // untuk mengirim notifikasi ke perangkat user.
  //
  // Satu user dapat memiliki lebih dari satu token karena
  // user dapat login menggunakan beberapa perangkat.
  //
  // Contoh:
  //
  // HP:
  // token = "token_hp"
  //
  // Laptop:
  // token = "token_laptop"
  //
  // Firestore:
  //
  // fcmTokens:
  // [
  //   "token_hp",
  //   "token_laptop"
  // ]
  //
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<void> simpanFcmToken({
    required String uid,
    required String token,
  }) async {
    await users.doc(uid).set(
      {
        'fcmTokens': FieldValue.arrayUnion([token]),
      },
      SetOptions(merge: true),
    );
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // UPDATE DATA USER
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<void> updateUser({
    required String uid,
    String? nama,
    String? jenisKelamin,
    String? tempatLahir,
    String? tanggalLahir,
    String? golonganDarah,
    String? nomorTelepon,
    String? alamat,
    String? fotoProfil,
  }) async {
    final Map<String, dynamic> data = {};

    // ======================================================
    // NAMA
    // ======================================================

    if (nama != null) {
      data['nama'] = nama;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // JENIS KELAMIN
    // ======================================================

    if (jenisKelamin != null) {
      data['jenisKelamin'] = jenisKelamin;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // TEMPAT LAHIR
    // ======================================================

    if (tempatLahir != null) {
      data['tempatLahir'] = tempatLahir;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // TANGGAL LAHIR
    // ======================================================

    if (tanggalLahir != null) {
      data['tanggalLahir'] = tanggalLahir;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // GOLONGAN DARAH
    // ======================================================

    if (golonganDarah != null) {
      data['golonganDarah'] = golonganDarah;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // NOMOR TELEPON
    // ======================================================

    if (nomorTelepon != null) {
      data['nomorTelepon'] = nomorTelepon;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // ALAMAT
    // ======================================================

    if (alamat != null) {
      data['alamat'] = alamat;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // FOTO PROFIL
    // ======================================================

    if (fotoProfil != null) {
      data['fotoProfil'] = fotoProfil;
    }

    // ======================================================
    // UPDATE JIKA ADA DATA
    // ======================================================

    if (data.isNotEmpty) {
      await users.doc(uid).update(data);
    }
  }
}

===== C:\Users\USER\sistem-antrian-klinik\lib\services\fcm_service.dart =====
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';
import 'package:firebase_messaging/firebase_messaging.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';

import 'database_service.dart';

class FcmService {
  // ==========================================================
  // INSTANCE FIREBASE MESSAGING
  // ==========================================================

  static final FirebaseMessaging _messaging =
      FirebaseMessaging.instance;

  // ==========================================================
  // VAPID PUBLIC KEY UNTUK WEB
  // ==========================================================
  //
  // Nanti isi dengan VAPID public key dari Firebase Console.
  //
  // Untuk sementara dikosongkan terlebih dahulu.
  //
  // Contoh:
  //
  // static const String vapidKey =
  //     'Bxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx';
  //
  // ==========================================================

  static const String vapidKey = 'BDOOsGjQdd5nn6pRJiNeyxAEEKLW4wvDDNqHCPBcRfZnvfFEZGkkHy2oPD60XrbR2NWanusn80lIyri4DpXEdts';

  // ==========================================================
  // INITIALIZE FCM
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<void> initialize() async {
    try {
      // ======================================================
      // AMBIL USER YANG SEDANG LOGIN
      // ======================================================

      final User? user = FirebaseAuth.instance.currentUser;

      // Jika belum login, tidak perlu mengambil token.
      if (user == null) {
        debugPrint('FCM: Tidak ada user yang sedang login.');
        return;
      }

      // ======================================================
      // REQUEST PERMISSION
      // ======================================================
      //
      // Android 13+ dan Web membutuhkan izin notifikasi.
      //
      // ======================================================

      final NotificationSettings settings =
          await _messaging.requestPermission(
        alert: true,
        badge: true,
        sound: true,
        provisional: false,
      );

      debugPrint(
        'FCM permission: ${settings.authorizationStatus}',
      );

      // ======================================================
      // CEK STATUS PERMISSION
      // ======================================================

      if (settings.authorizationStatus ==
          AuthorizationStatus.denied) {
        debugPrint('FCM: Izin notifikasi ditolak.');
        return;
      }

      // ======================================================
      // MENGAMBIL TOKEN FCM
      // ======================================================

      String? token;

      if (kIsWeb) {
        // ====================================================
        // WEB
        // ====================================================
        //
        // Web membutuhkan VAPID public key.
        //
        // ====================================================

        if (vapidKey.isEmpty) {
          debugPrint(
            'FCM: VAPID key belum diisi. '
            'Konfigurasi Web belum lengkap.',
          );
          return;
        }

        token = await _messaging.getToken(
          vapidKey: vapidKey,
        );
      } else {
        // ====================================================
        // ANDROID
        // ====================================================

        token = await _messaging.getToken();
      }

      // ======================================================
      // SIMPAN TOKEN KE FIRESTORE
      // ======================================================

      if (token != null && token.isNotEmpty) {
        debugPrint('FCM Token berhasil didapatkan.');
        debugPrint(token);

        await DatabaseService.simpanFcmToken(
          uid: user.uid,
          token: token,
        );

        debugPrint(
          'FCM Token berhasil disimpan ke Firestore.',
        );
      } else {
        debugPrint('FCM: Token tidak tersedia.');
      }

      // ======================================================
      // TOKEN REFRESH
      // ======================================================
      //
      // Firebase dapat mengganti token perangkat.
      // Karena itu kita harus menyimpan token terbaru.
      //
      // ======================================================

      _messaging.onTokenRefresh.listen(
        (newToken) async {
          try {
            debugPrint('FCM Token diperbarui.');

            await DatabaseService.simpanFcmToken(
              uid: user.uid,
              token: newToken,
            );

            debugPrint(
              'FCM Token baru berhasil disimpan.',
            );
          } catch (e) {
            debugPrint(
              'Gagal menyimpan FCM Token baru: $e',
            );
          }
        },
      );
    } catch (e) {
      // ======================================================
      // ERROR HANDLING
      // ======================================================

      debugPrint(
        'FCM initialization error: $e',
      );
    }
  }
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:firebase_auth/firebase_auth.dart';

import '../models/kepuasan_layanan.dart';

class KepuasanService {
  final FirebaseFirestore _db = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
  final FirebaseAuth _auth = FirebaseAuth.instance;

  CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> get _koleksiPenilaian =>
      _db.collection('penilaian_layanan');

  /// Memeriksa apakah antrean sudah memiliki penilaian.
  Future<bool> sudahDinilai(String idAntrean) async {
    final doc = await _koleksiPenilaian.doc(idAntrean).get();
    return doc.exists;
  }

  /// Menyimpan penilaian.
  ///
  /// ID dokumen penilaian menggunakan ID dokumen antrean.
  /// Dengan demikian, satu antrean hanya mempunyai satu dokumen penilaian.
  Future<void> kirimPenilaian({
    required String idAntrean,
    required int ratingKeseluruhan,
    required int ratingPetugas,
    required int ratingWaktuTunggu,
    required int ratingDokter,
    required String komentar,
  }) async {
    final user = _auth.currentUser;

    if (user == null) {
      throw Exception('Silakan login terlebih dahulu.');
    }

    if ([
      ratingKeseluruhan,
      ratingPetugas,
      ratingWaktuTunggu,
      ratingDokter,
    ].any((rating) => rating < 1 || rating > 5)) {
      throw Exception('Semua rating harus antara 1 sampai 5.');
    }

    final antreanRef = _db.collection('antrean').doc(idAntrean);
    final penilaianRef = _koleksiPenilaian.doc(idAntrean);

    // Transaction membantu mencegah pengiriman ganda.
    await _db.runTransaction((transaction) async {
      final antreanDoc = await transaction.get(antreanRef);
      final penilaianDoc = await transaction.get(penilaianRef);

      if (!antreanDoc.exists) {
        throw Exception('Data antrean tidak ditemukan.');
      }

      if (penilaianDoc.exists) {
        throw Exception('Antrean ini sudah pernah dinilai.');
      }

      final antrean = antreanDoc.data()!;
      final uidAntrean = antrean['uid'] as String?;
      final status = antrean['status'] as String?;

      if (uidAntrean != user.uid) {
        throw Exception('Kamu tidak berhak menilai antrean ini.');
      }

      if (status != 'Selesai') {
        throw Exception('Penilaian hanya dapat diberikan setelah antrean selesai.');
      }

      final userDoc = await transaction.get(
        _db.collection('users').doc(user.uid),
      );

      final dataUser = userDoc.data();
      final namaPasien =
          (dataUser?['nama'] as String?)?.trim().isNotEmpty == true
              ? (dataUser!['nama'] as String).trim()
              : (user.displayName ?? 'Pasien');

      transaction.set(penilaianRef, {
        'uidPasien': user.uid,
        'idAntrean': idAntrean,
        'namaPasien': namaPasien,
        'namaPoli': antrean['namaPoli'] ?? '-',
        'dokter': antrean['dokter'] ?? '-',
        'ratingKeseluruhan': ratingKeseluruhan,
        'ratingPetugas': ratingPetugas,
        'ratingWaktuTunggu': ratingWaktuTunggu,
        'ratingDokter': ratingDokter,
        'komentar': komentar.trim(),
        'tanggalPenilaian': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
      });
    });
  }

  /// Stream semua penilaian untuk dashboard petugas.
  Stream<List<KepuasanLayanan>> streamSemuaPenilaian() {
    return _koleksiPenilaian.snapshots().map((snapshot) {
      final daftar = snapshot.docs
          .map((doc) => KepuasanLayanan.dariFirestore(doc))
          .toList();

      daftar.sort((a, b) {
        final waktuA = a.tanggalPenilaian?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0;
        final waktuB = b.tanggalPenilaian?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0;
        return waktuB.compareTo(waktuA);
      });

      return daftar;
    });
  }

  /// Stream penilaian untuk satu pasien.
  Stream<List<KepuasanLayanan>> streamPenilaianPasien(String uid) {
    return _koleksiPenilaian
        .where('uidPasien', isEqualTo: uid)
        .snapshots()
        .map((snapshot) {
      final daftar = snapshot.docs
          .map((doc) => KepuasanLayanan.dariFirestore(doc))
          .toList();

      daftar.sort((a, b) {
        final waktuA = a.tanggalPenilaian?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0;
        final waktuB = b.tanggalPenilaian?.millisecondsSinceEpoch ?? 0;
        return waktuB.compareTo(waktuA);
      });

      return daftar;
    });
  }
}

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';

import '../models/konsultasi.dart';

class KonsultasiService {
  static final CollectionReference konsultasiCollection = FirebaseFirestore
      .instance
      .collection('konsultasi');

  // ==========================================================
  // SIMPAN DATA KONSULTASI
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<void> simpanKonsultasi({
    required String uid,
    required Konsultasi konsultasi,
  }) async {
    await konsultasiCollection.add({
      'uid': uid,
      'namaPasien': konsultasi.namaPasien,
      'dokter': konsultasi.dokter,
      'poli': konsultasi.poli,
      'tanggal': konsultasi.tanggal,
      'jam': konsultasi.jam,
      'keluhan': konsultasi.keluhan,

      // ======================================================
      // STATUS AWAL KONSULTASI
      // ======================================================
      'status': 'Menunggu',

      // ======================================================
      // WAKTU DATA DIBUAT
      // ======================================================
      'createdAt': FieldValue.serverTimestamp(),
    });
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // MENGAMBIL NAMA PASIEN
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<String> ambilNamaPasien(String uid) async {
    final DocumentSnapshot snapshot = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
        .collection('users')
        .doc(uid)
        .get();

    // ========================================================
    // JIKA DATA USER TIDAK DITEMUKAN
    // ========================================================

    if (!snapshot.exists) {
      return 'Pasien';
    }

    // ========================================================
    // MENGUBAH DATA FIRESTORE MENJADI MAP
    // ========================================================

    final Map<String, dynamic> data = snapshot.data() as Map<String, dynamic>;

    // ========================================================
    // MENGAMBIL NAMA PASIEN
    // ========================================================

    return data['nama'] ?? 'Pasien';
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // MENGAMBIL RIWAYAT KONSULTASI
  // ==========================================================

  static Stream<QuerySnapshot> ambilRiwayatKonsultasi(String uid) {
    return konsultasiCollection.where('uid', isEqualTo: uid).snapshots();
  }

  // ==========================================================
  // MENGUBAH STATUS KONSULTASI
  // ==========================================================

  static Future<void> updateStatusKonsultasi({
    required String documentId,
    required String status,
  }) async {
    await konsultasiCollection.doc(documentId).update({'status': status});
  }
}

class NotificationService {
  static final FlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin flutterLocalNotificationsPlugin =

        AndroidInitializationSettings('@mipmap/ic_launcher');

        InitializationSettings(android: initializationSettingsAndroid);

      settings: initializationSettings,
    );

        .resolvePlatformSpecificImplementation<
          AndroidFlutterLocalNotificationsPlugin
        >()
        ?.requestNotificationsPermission();
  }

===== C:\Users\USER\sistem-antrian-klinik\lib\widgets\status_badge.dart =====
import 'package:flutter/material.dart';

import '../themes/app_colors.dart';

class StatusBadge extends StatelessWidget {
  final String status;

  const StatusBadge({super.key, required this.status});

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    Color warna;
    IconData icon;

    switch (status) {
      case 'Menunggu':
        warna = AppColors.warning;
        icon = Icons.access_time;

        break;

      case 'Dipanggil':
        warna = AppColors.primary;
        icon = Icons.campaign;

        break;

      case 'Selesai':
        warna = AppColors.success;
        icon = Icons.check_circle;

        break;

      case 'Dibatalkan':
        warna = AppColors.danger;
        icon = Icons.cancel;

        break;

      default:
        warna = Colors.grey;
        icon = Icons.info;
    }

    return Container(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: 12, vertical: 6),

      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        color: warna.withValues(alpha: 0.1),

        borderRadius: BorderRadius.circular(20),
      ),

      child: Row(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,

        children: [
          Icon(icon, size: 16, color: warna),

          const SizedBox(width: 5),

          Text(
            status,

            style: TextStyle(
              color: warna,
              fontWeight: FontWeight.bold,
              fontSize: 12,
            ),
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

// This is a basic Flutter widget test.
//
// To perform an interaction with a widget in your test, use the WidgetTester
// utility in the flutter_test package. For example, you can send tap and scroll
// gestures. You can also use WidgetTester to find child widgets in the widget
// tree, read text, and verify that the values of widget properties are correct.

import 'package:flutter/material.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

import 'package:flutter_application_2/main.dart';

void main() {
  testWidgets('Counter increments smoke test', (WidgetTester tester) async {
    // Build our app and trigger a frame.
    await tester.pumpWidget(const KlinikApp());

    // Verify that our counter starts at 0.
    expect(find.text('0'), findsOneWidget);
    expect(find.text('1'), findsNothing);

    // Tap the '+' icon and trigger a frame.
    await tester.tap(find.byIcon(Icons.add));
    await tester.pump();

    // Verify that our counter has incremented.
    expect(find.text('0'), findsNothing);
    expect(find.text('1'), findsOneWidget);
  });

  await Firebase.initializeApp(options: defaultFirebaseOptions);
  runApp(FirestoreExampleApp());
}

/// A reference to the list of movies.
/// We are using `withConverter` to ensure that interactions with the collection
/// are type-safe.
final moviesRef = FirebaseFirestore.instance
    .collection('firestore-example-app')
    .withConverter<Movie>(
      fromFirestore: (snapshots, _) => Movie.fromJson(snapshots.data()!),
      toFirestore: (movie, _) => movie.toJson(),
    );

/// The different ways that we can filter/sort movies.
enum MovieQuery {
  year,
  likesAsc,
  likesDesc,
  score,
  sciFi,
  fantasy,
}

extension on Query<Movie> {
  /// Create a firebase query from a [MovieQuery]
  Query<Movie> queryBy(MovieQuery query) {
    return switch (query) {
      MovieQuery.fantasy => where('genre', arrayContainsAny: ['Fantasy']),
      MovieQuery.sciFi => where('genre', arrayContainsAny: ['Sci-Fi']),
      MovieQuery.likesAsc ||
      MovieQuery.likesDesc =>
        orderBy('likes', descending: query == MovieQuery.likesDesc),
      MovieQuery.year => orderBy('year', descending: true),
      MovieQuery.score => orderBy('score', descending: true)
    };
  }
}

/// The entry point of the application.
///
/// Returns a [MaterialApp].
class FirestoreExampleApp extends StatelessWidget {
  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return MaterialApp(
      title: 'Firestore Example App',
      theme: ThemeData.dark(),
      home: const Scaffold(
        body: Center(child: FilmList()),
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Holds all example app films
class FilmList extends StatefulWidget {
  const FilmList({Key? key}) : super(key: key);

  @override
  _FilmListState createState() => _FilmListState();
}

class _FilmListState extends State<FilmList> {
  MovieQuery query = MovieQuery.year;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Scaffold(
      appBar: AppBar(
        title: Column(
          mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
          crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
          children: [
            const Text('Firestore Example: Movies'),

            // This is a example use for 'snapshots in sync'.
            // The view reflects the time of the last Firestore sync; which happens any time a field is updated.
            StreamBuilder(
              stream: FirebaseFirestore.instance.snapshotsInSync(),
              builder: (context, _) {
                return Text(
                  'Latest Snapshot: ${DateTime.now()}',
                  style: Theme.of(context).textTheme.bodySmall,
                );
              },
            ),
          ],
        ),
        actions: <Widget>[
          PopupMenuButton<MovieQuery>(
            onSelected: (value) => setState(() => query = value),
            icon: const Icon(Icons.sort),
            itemBuilder: (BuildContext context) {
              return [
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: MovieQuery.year,
                  child: Text('Sort by Year'),
                ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: MovieQuery.score,
                  child: Text('Sort by Score'),
                ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: MovieQuery.likesAsc,
                  child: Text('Sort by Likes ascending'),
                ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: MovieQuery.likesDesc,
                  child: Text('Sort by Likes descending'),
                ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: MovieQuery.fantasy,
                  child: Text('Filter genre Fantasy'),
                ),
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: MovieQuery.sciFi,
                  child: Text('Filter genre Sci-Fi'),
                ),
              ];
            },
          ),
          PopupMenuButton<String>(
            onSelected: (_) => _resetLikes(),
            itemBuilder: (BuildContext context) {
              return [
                const PopupMenuItem(
                  value: 'reset_likes',
                  child: Text('Reset like counts (WriteBatch)'),
                ),
              ];
            },
          ),
        ],
      ),
      body: StreamBuilder<QuerySnapshot<Movie>>(
        stream: moviesRef.queryBy(query).snapshots(),
        builder: (context, snapshot) {
          if (snapshot.hasError) {
            return Center(
              child: Text(snapshot.error.toString()),
            );
          }

          if (!snapshot.hasData) {
            return const Center(child: CircularProgressIndicator());
          }

          final data = snapshot.requireData;

          return ListView.builder(
            itemCount: data.size,
            itemBuilder: (context, index) {
              return _MovieItem(
                data.docs[index].data(),
                data.docs[index].reference,
              );
            },
          );
        },
      ),
    );
  }

  Future<void> _resetLikes() async {
    final movies = await moviesRef.get();
    WriteBatch batch = FirebaseFirestore.instance.batch();

    for (final movie in movies.docs) {
      batch.update(movie.reference, {'likes': 0});
    }
    await batch.commit();
  }
}

/// A single movie row.
class _MovieItem extends StatelessWidget {
  _MovieItem(this.movie, this.reference);

  final Movie movie;
  final DocumentReference<Movie> reference;

  /// Returns the movie poster.
  Widget get poster {
    return SizedBox(
      width: 100,
      child: Image.network(movie.poster),
    );
  }

  /// Returns movie details.
  Widget get details {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(left: 8, right: 8),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          title,
          metadata,
          genres,
          Likes(
            reference: reference,
            currentLikes: movie.likes,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Return the movie title.
  Widget get title {
    return Text(
      '${movie.title} (${movie.year})',
      style: const TextStyle(fontSize: 18, fontWeight: FontWeight.bold),
    );
  }

  /// Returns metadata about the movie.
  Widget get metadata {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      child: Column(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          Padding(
            padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 8),
            child: Text('Rated: ${movie.rated}'),
          ),
          Text('Runtime: ${movie.runtime}'),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }

  /// Returns a list of genre movie tags.
  List<Widget> get genreItems {
    return [
      for (final genre in movie.genre)
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: 2),
          child: Chip(
            backgroundColor: Colors.lightBlue,
            label: Text(
              genre,
              style: const TextStyle(color: Colors.white),
            ),
          ),
        ),
    ];
  }

  /// Returns all genres.
  Widget get genres {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(top: 8),
      child: Wrap(
        children: genreItems,
      ),
    );
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Padding(
      padding: const EdgeInsets.only(bottom: 4, top: 4),
      child: Row(
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
        children: [
          poster,
          Flexible(child: details),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}

/// Displays and manages the movie 'like' count.
class Likes extends StatefulWidget {
  /// Constructs a new [Likes] instance with a given [DocumentReference] and
  /// current like count.
  Likes({
    Key? key,
    required this.reference,
    required this.currentLikes,
  }) : super(key: key);

  /// The reference relating to the counter.
  final DocumentReference<Movie> reference;

  /// The number of current likes (before manipulation).
  final int currentLikes;

  @override
  _LikesState createState() => _LikesState();
}

class _LikesState extends State<Likes> {
  /// A local cache of the current likes, used to immediately render the updated
  /// likes count after an update, even while the request isn't completed yet.
  late int _likes = widget.currentLikes;

  Future<void> _onLike() async {
    final currentLikes = _likes;

    // Increment the 'like' count straight away to show feedback to the user.
    setState(() {
      _likes = currentLikes + 1;
    });

    try {
      // Update the likes using a transaction.
      // We use a transaction because multiple users could update the likes count
      // simultaneously. As such, our likes count may be different from the likes
      // count on the server.
      int newLikes = await FirebaseFirestore.instance
          .runTransaction<int>((transaction) async {
        DocumentSnapshot<Movie> movie =
            await transaction.get<Movie>(widget.reference);

        if (!movie.exists) {
          throw Exception('Document does not exist!');
        }

        int updatedLikes = movie.data()!.likes + 1;
        transaction.update(widget.reference, {'likes': updatedLikes});
        return updatedLikes;
      });

      // Update with the real count once the transaction has completed.
      setState(() => _likes = newLikes);
    } catch (e, s) {
      print(s);
      print('Failed to update likes for document! $e');

      // If the transaction fails, revert back to the old count
      setState(() => _likes = currentLikes);
    }
  }

  @override
  void didUpdateWidget(Likes oldWidget) {
    super.didUpdateWidget(oldWidget);
    // The likes on the server changed, so we need to update our local cache to
    // keep things in sync. Otherwise if another user updates the likes,
    // we won't see the update.
    if (widget.currentLikes != oldWidget.currentLikes) {
      _likes = widget.currentLikes;
    }
  }

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    return Row(
      children: [
        IconButton(
          iconSize: 20,
          onPressed: _onLike,
          icon: const Icon(Icons.favorite),
        ),
        Text('$_likes likes'),
      ],
    );
  }
}

@immutable
class Movie {
  Movie({
    required this.genre,
    required this.likes,
    required this.poster,
    required this.rated,
    required this.runtime,
    required this.title,
    required this.year,
  });

  Movie.fromJson(Map<String, Object?> json)
      : this(
          genre: (json['genre']! as List).cast<String>(),
          likes: json['likes']! as int,
          poster: json['poster']! as String,
          rated: json['rated']! as String,
          runtime: json['runtime']! as String,
          title: json['title']! as String,
          year: json['year']! as int,
        );

  final String poster;
  final int likes;
  final String title;
  final int year;
  final String runtime;
  final String rated;
  final List<String> genre;

  Map<String, Object?> toJson() {
    return {
      'genre': genre,
      'likes': likes,
      'poster': poster,
      'rated': rated,
      'runtime': runtime,
      'title': title,
      'year': year,
    };
  }
}

import 'dart:math';

import 'package:cloud_firestore/cloud_firestore.dart';
import 'package:flutter/foundation.dart';
import 'package:flutter_test/flutter_test.dart';

void runCollectionReferenceTests() {
  group('$CollectionReference', () {
    late FirebaseFirestore firestore;

    setUpAll(() async {
      firestore = FirebaseFirestore.instance;
    });

    Future<CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>>> initializeTest(
      String id,
    ) async {
      CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> collection =
          firestore.collection('flutter-tests/$id/query-tests');
      QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snapshot = await collection.get();

      await Future.forEach(snapshot.docs,
          (DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> documentSnapshot) {
        return documentSnapshot.reference.delete();
      });
      return collection;
    }

    test('add() adds a document', () async {
      CollectionReference<Map<String, dynamic>> collection =
          await initializeTest('collection-reference-add');
      var rand = Random();
      var randNum = rand.nextInt(999999);
      DocumentReference<Map<String, dynamic>> doc = await collection.add({
        'value': randNum,
      });
      DocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>> snapshot = await doc.get();
      expect(randNum, equals(snapshot.data()!['value']));
    });

    test(
      'snapshots() can be reused',
      () async {
        final foo = await initializeTest('foo');

        final snapshot = foo.snapshots();
        final snapshot2 = foo.snapshots();

        expect(
          await snapshot.first,
          isA<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
              .having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', []),
        );
        expect(
          await snapshot2.first,
          isA<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
              .having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', []),
        );

        await foo.add({'value': 42});

        expect(
          await snapshot.first,
          isA<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
              .having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', [
            isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot>()
                .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', {'value': 42}),
          ]),
        );
        expect(
          await snapshot2.first,
          isA<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
              .having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', [
            isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
                .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', {'value': 42}),
          ]),
        );
      },
      skip: defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.windows,
    );

    group(
      'withConverter',
      () {
        test(
          'add/snapshot',
          () async {
            final foo = await initializeTest('foo');
            final fooConverter = foo.withConverter<int>(
              fromFirestore: (snapshots, _) =>
                  snapshots.data()!['value']! as int,
              toFirestore: (value, _) => {'value': value},
            );

            final fooSnapshot = foo.snapshots();
            final fooConverterSnapshot = fooConverter.snapshots();

            await expectLater(
              fooSnapshot,
              emits(
                isA<QuerySnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
                    .having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', []),
              ),
            );
            await expectLater(
              fooConverterSnapshot,
              emits(
                isA<QuerySnapshot<int>>().having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', []),
              ),
            );

            final newDocument = await fooConverter.add(42);

            await expectLater(
              newDocument.get(),
              completion(
                isA<DocumentSnapshot<int>>()
                    .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', 42),
              ),
            );

            await expectLater(
              fooSnapshot,
              emits(
                isA<QuerySnapshot>().having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', [
                  isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot>()
                      .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', {'value': 42}),
                ]),
              ),
            );
            await expectLater(
              fooConverterSnapshot,
              emits(
                isA<QuerySnapshot<int>>().having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', [
                  isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<int>>()
                      .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', 42),
                ]),
              ),
            );

            await foo.add({'value': 21});

            await expectLater(
              fooSnapshot,
              emits(
                isA<QuerySnapshot>().having(
                  (e) => e.docs,
                  'docs',
                  unorderedEquals([
                    isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
                        .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', {'value': 42}),
                    isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Map<String, dynamic>>>()
                        .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', {'value': 21}),
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
            );

            await expectLater(
              fooConverterSnapshot,
              emits(
                isA<QuerySnapshot<int>>().having(
                  (e) => e.docs,
                  'docs',
                  unorderedEquals([
                    isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<int>>()
                        .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', 42),
                    isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<int>>()
                        .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', 21),
                  ]),
                ),
              ),
            );
          },
          timeout: const Timeout.factor(3),
        );

        test(
          'returning null from `fromFirestore` should not throw a null check error',
          () async {
            final foo = await initializeTest('foo');
            await foo.add({'value': 42});
            final fooConverter = foo.withConverter(
              fromFirestore: (_, __) => null,
              toFirestore: (_, __) => {}, // unused
            );

            final fooConverterSnapshot = fooConverter.snapshots();

            await expectLater(
              fooConverterSnapshot,
              emits(
                // ignore: prefer_void_to_null
                isA<QuerySnapshot<Null>>().having((e) => e.docs, 'docs', [
                  // ignore: prefer_void_to_null
                  isA<QueryDocumentSnapshot<Null>>()
                      .having((e) => e.data(), 'data', null),
                ]),
              ),
            );
          },
        );
      },
      skip: defaultTargetPlatform == TargetPlatform.windows,
    );
  });
}
